title: Dunyodagi eng chuqur ko'lning tubi qayerda?

scenes.text: Rossiyaning Sibir qismidagi Baykal ko'lining eng chuqur joyi 1642 metr.
Bu dunyodagi eng chuqur ko'l. Uning tubi okean sathidan ham ancha pastda joylashgan.
Baykalda Yer yuzidagi muzlamagan chuchuk suvning taxminan 20 foizi bor.
Ko'l taxminan 25 million yil oldin paydo bo'lgan. Uni dunyodagi eng qadimgi ko'l deb hisoblashadi.

description:
Baykal ko'lining eng chuqur nuqtasi 1642 metr, bu dunyodagi eng chuqur ko'l. Unda Yer yuzidagi muzlamagan chuchuk suvning taxminan 20 foizi saqlanadi, yoshi esa taxminan 25 million yil deb baholanadi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). TRUE with rounding: max depth 1,642 m (1992 survey; older sources give 1,620-1,637 m); share of unfrozen fresh water estimated 19-23%, 'taxminan 20 foiz' is fair; age 25-30 million years in most sources (Britannica says 20-25 million), 'taxminan 25 million' is fair; oldest lake in the world; surface about 456 m above sea level, so the bottom is about 1,186 m below sea level.
